basic_info.name: Washington Metalworks
basic_info.description: 200+ people. 150,000 sq ft. Over 40 years of sheet metal expertise. Washington Metalworks was founded in 1985 by Steve Tate, aged just 26, from a 500 sq ft unit on Swan Industrial Estate. At the time, the plant list was simple: a guillotine, a 4 ft hand-folding machine and a stick welder. That was the starting point. Today, we are a 220-strong team operating from a 150,000 sq ft facility, supplying OEM customers across the UK and Western Europe. While the scale has changed, the focus hasn’t — practical problem-solving, consistent delivery and doing the job properly. Steve now sits as Chairman, with that same long-term approach driving continued investment and growth into the next generation.

basic_info.name: Areco
basic_info.description: Areco is a privately owned Swedish company founded in 1944 and today is one of the leading players in the sheet metal industry. basic_info.name: Cutting Edge Fabrication - Milwaukee, WI
basic_info.description: Cutting Edge Fabrication (CEF) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified metal fabrication company specializing in welding medium to large metal structures and components. The company has been conducting business since 1990 in Milwaukee, WI. CEF fabrication services include welding, metal forming, metal bending, plate cutting, laser cutting, plasma cutting, oxy-fuel cutting, sheering, production sawing, CNC machining, and final assembly. CEF fabrication capabilities include processing raw material to finished product fabrications, state-of-the-art laser plate cutting, high-performance production sawing, precision CNC machining, full assembly services, and quality inspection.Cutting Edge Fabrication’s high-level of customer satisfaction results from providing the highest-quality metal fabrication products and services available. We continuously strive to excel in all manufacturing processes utilizing the best quality standards, ongoing workforce training and well-maintained production equipment. Our dedication to quality is absolute and without compromise as we focus on delivering 100% customer satisfaction.

basic_info.name: JK Welding

basic_info.name: MacDonald Steel Limited
basic_info.description: MacDonald Steel, founded in 1957, is a custom steel fabrication and machining plant. Our facility sits on 20 acres of land and the plant floor consists of 190 000 sq ft of fabrication space.  MacDonald Steel includes three divisions; Custom Fabricating, Environmental Systems Division and Specialty Products.  The custom fabrication side of our business manufactures products to our customers’ drawings and specifications.  We manufacture parts weighing only a few pounds to items that require special permitting to ship due to size or weight.  Our facility provides one stop shopping for our customers. Environmental Systems division designs, manufactures, installs and services our own dust collectors (Shaker, Reverse Air, Pulse), Cyclones, Rotary Air Locks, Fans, Spark Systems and Bin Covers.  Our 50 years of experience is leveraged to offer our customers an exceptional line of products to suit their application.  The Specialty Products division combines the disciplines of design, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of brew-on-the premise systems and equipment.  Our brew-on premise equipment packages are built to the highest standard in the industry.MacDonald Steel personnel and welding procedures are certified to CSA W47.1 in the fusion welding of steel products.  We have earned American Society for Mechanical Engineers Certification as well as Ontario Technical Standards and Safety Act certification in pressure vessel manufacturing and repairs.

basic_info.name: Prince Service & Mfg.
basic_info.description: For 55 years the Prince name has been synonymous with quality metalwork. Servicing the customer with a superior product on time has been an unchanging goal for the company from its humble beginnings in founder Joe Prince’s garage as Prince Sheet Metal to its current state as a cutting edge business employing over 100 skilled workers and utilizing multiple facilities equipped with state of the art machinery. While the look and size of the company has changed, its goals and underlying focus have not, to serve our customers.Founded originally around a business model of fast response to local industry shut down work and providing an array of metal fabrication to support the community and satisfy the customer, Prince Sheet Metal earned a hard-fought reputation as being willing to serve. This approach has been passed down through generations and is now also applied to production run parts with an equal sense of urgency, accountability and reliability at each of its two current locations. Prince Service and Manufacturing (PSM) focuses on heavy metal fabrication and industrial service work, targeting a similar market as the original company. Prince Precision Products is an ISO 9001:2015 certified facility that started in 2008 to focus on larger volume sheet metal fabrication. The two facilities complement each other well and the resulting organization is one that has the flexibility, skill and manpower to provide solutions to nearly any problem in the metal fabrication industry across the southeastern United States.At Prince we value partnerships forged over time. We maintain focus on our customers and strive to be the company our customers turn to when they have a problem, understanding that satisfied customers come back again and again to do business. For any metal parts ranging from intricate, tight tolerance machining to heavy plate fabrication of large weldments, we want to be that trusted partner you turn to.

basic_info.name: Evansville Sheet Metal Works, Inc.
basic_info.description: Evansville Sheet Metal Works (ESMW) is a custom metal fabrication company that handles work ranging from custom components and equipment modifications to large fabrication projects and one-off specialty work. Founded in 1946 and based in Evansville, Indiana, ESMW is a third-generation, family-owned company.A project can start with a finished print, an existing part, a concept, or a problem that still needs a fabrication path. When the work goes beyond straightforward print-to-part, we combine the customer’s knowledge of how the finished work needs to function with ESMW’s fabrication experience to determine a practical path forward.Our capabilities include custom metal fabrication, welding, laser cutting, dynamic waterjet cutting, CNC punching, machining, laser inspection and reverse engineering, forming and rolling, fabricated assemblies, equipment modifications, and field fabrication and installation. We work with stainless steel, aluminum, carbon and mild steel, copper, brass, other metals required by the work, and select nonmetallic materials including UHMW and nylon.Manufacturing and industrial work are an important part of ESMW’s business, with particular experience in food manufacturing, processing, and pharmaceutical applications. We also take on specialty and one-off fabrication when the project is a strong fit.Based in Evansville, ESMW works with customers locally, regionally, and nationwide.Cut2SizeMetals.com is the online metal sales division of Evansville Sheet Metal Works, providing an online path for custom-cut metal and other straightforward metal needs.
